# Sources

| File | Source | License |
|:--- |:--- |:--- |
| `own_netflix_checks.srt` | Written for this repository. SubRip with BOM, CR LF, core markup, an entity and German and French letters. Each cue breaks a known set of the Netflix English rules. | MIT |
| `own_text_checks.vtt` | Written for this repository. WebVTT with core markup, voices, an entity, a non-breaking space, en dashes and French letters. The cues break a known set of the text rules. | MIT |
| `own_webvtt_tags.vtt` | Written for this repository. WebVTT with `<c>`, `<lang>`, `<ruby>`, `<rt>` and `<v>` tags, upper case tag names and Japanese letters. Some cues leave a tag open or close a tag that never opened. | MIT |
